description: Defines the Consultation immutable data model representing a doctor-patient appointment, including factory methods for JSON serialization/deserialization and a copyWith method.

classes.name: Consultation
classes.description: An immutable class representing a consultation with properties like id, patientId, doctorId, date, and notes; includes methods for JSON conversion and copying with modifications.

methods.name: Consultation.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Consultation instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the Consultation instance into a JSON map.

methods.name: copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the Consultation instance with optional new values for fields.
